title: IQ Demodulator
text: Convert RF signal to baseband signal, {Filter type} sets Filter type; {Source of conversion gain} sets the source parameter of conversion gain Available power, {Available power gain} sets the ratio of power of SSB at output I branch to input power, {Open circuit voltage gain}, {Polynomial coefficients} sets the coefficients of polynomial specifying voltage gain, {Local oscillator frequency}, {Input impedance (Ohm)} sets the input impedance of IQ demodulator, {Output impedance (Ohm)} sets the output impedance of IQ demodulator, {Add Image Reject filter} sets the image reject, {Add Channel Select filters} sets the channel select, {Ground and hide negative terminals} sets the ground and hide circuit terminals, {Edit System} sets the break IQ demodulator block links and replace internal variables by appropriate values, {I/Q gain mismatch} sets the gain difference between I and Q branches, {I/Q phase mismatch} sets the phase difference between I and Q branches, {LO to RF isolation} sets the ratio of magnitude between LO voltage to leaked RF voltage inf, {Noise figure (dB)} sets the signal-to-noise ratio, {Add phase noise}, {Phase noise frequency offset (Hz)}, {Phase noise level (dBc/Hz)} sets the phase noise level, {Automatically estimate impulse response duration}, {Impulse response duration}, {Plot phase noise characteristics} sets the phase noise magnitude, {Nonlinear polynomial type} sets the polynomial nonlinearity Even, {Intercept points convention}, {IP2} sets the second-order intercept point, {IP3} sets the third-order intercept point, {1-dB gain compression power}, {Output saturation power}, {Gain compression at saturation}, {Design method} sets the simulation type, {Implementation}, {Passband edge frequency}, {Implement using filter order}, {Filter order}, {Passband frequency}, {Passband frequencies}, {Passband attenuation (dB)} sets the passband attenuation 10*log10, {Stopband frequencies}, {Stopband edge frequencies}, {Stopband attenuation (dB)}, {Source impedance (Ohm)} sets the input source resistance, {Load impedance (Ohm)} sets the output load resistance and {Export} sets the save filter design. Values come from the instance.
